producer_report.summary: Moved SnapExec (with its Exec impl), take_baseline and baseline_checks verbatim from run/mod.rs into the new run/checks.rs. The only changes to the text are pub(super) on SnapExec, its fields and take_baseline, plus rustfmt wrapping of the take_baseline signature. mod.rs adds `mod checks;` and `use checks::SnapExec;`, and check_seam stays there so test paths do not change. Added a CHANGELOG entry with the caller checks and the early-return note. No test code changed. fmt and clippy are clean, the policy scan passes, and the 27 run:: tests pass. I did not run the full suite or the full test list.

mistakes: The first CHANGELOG draft used a banned word and a wrong new line number (76 instead of 68). Both fixed and the policy test re-run.
learnings: run/ submodules use `use super::*;`, so private items in mod.rs, including the cfg(test) check_seam module, are visible to children without edits.
The policy scan rejects the word 'operators' even in a phrase about the Rust `?` operator.
